en.title: Major Funding Boost and Policy Updates Advance Disability Accessibility
en.summary: The Cleveland Regional Transit Authority received a $20 million federal grant to make the entire Green Line fully accessible for people with disabilities. In Taiwan, Taichung City extended its home‑accessibility subsidy to a maximum of NT 2.16 million, while BiblioCommons announced a partnership with Level Access to redesign its digital platforms for WCAG compliance. Additional initiatives include GoodMaps’ indoor GPS navigation app in Fort Wayne and the Deaf Art Science Festival in Melbourne focusing on disaster‑response accessibility.

highlights.title: RTA awarded $20M in grants to make entire Green Line accessible for people with disabilities
Taichung extends home accessibility subsidy up to NT$2.16 million through October 31
BiblioCommons Partners With Level Access to Overhaul Its Accessibility Approaches
GoodMaps mobile app brings indoor GPS navigation, accessibility tools to two Fort Wayne destinations
Deaf Art Science Festival will explore accessibility in emergency and disaster response

zh-TW.title: 資金與政策推動全國無障礙環境提升
zh-TW.summary: 克利夫蘭地區交通局獲得 2000 萬美元聯邦補助金，將整條 Green Line 改造為無障礙。台中市延長居家無障礙補助，最高可領取 216 萬元新台幣；BiblioCommons 與 Level Access 合作，重新設計其數位平台以符合 WCAG 標準。其他亮點包括 GoodMaps 在福特韋恩推出室內 GPS 導航工具，以及墨爾本聾人藝術科學節探討災害應變的無障礙方案。

highlights.title: 克利夫蘭地區交通局獲得2000萬美元補助金，使整條Green Line對殘障人士無障礙
台中市延長居家無障礙最高補助216萬元，截止10月31日
BiblioCommons 與 Level Access 合作全面改進其無障礙方案
GoodMaps 行動應用程式帶來室內 GPS 導航與無障礙工具至福特韋恩兩處目的地
聾人藝術科學節將探討緊急與災害應對中的無障礙
